meaning: the reviewed identity of the cross-CLI occurrence ledger (CrossCliAccountingTest): per disposition catalog its sha256 and entry counts by disposition, vendor_declared and retained classification; the family and assertion-coverage tables' hashes; per registered source (fixture/artifact) its native sha256, profile, compatibility entry, record and occurrence counts, per-family classification counts (distinct templated paths and occurrences), exact gap ids (candidate, common_capacity_gap, unresolved, retained_unclassified, unclassified, ambiguous, no_catalog, unassigned-family) and unexercised catalog entries; and per class the assertion census by origin with every unjudged path. The test fails on any added or removed line, printing the delta: an edit here is the reviewable change, never its approval, and a pinned gap is visible debt, not an accepted one
